'''Writing''', or a '''writing system''', was a methodology of portraying notions, concepts, or vocal sounds of a particular language. Writing could be on paper or [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]], or displayed on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] or a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]. Many writing systems were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], perhaps at least one written script for each language.

[[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] was the formal and most common system for [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], although a Basic-speaking [[Planet/Legends|world]], also alternatively utilized two separate systems: [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]], for formal designations such as on a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] hull, and [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]], for informal writing.

''[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]'' was an article published in [[38 ABY]] to cover how the galaxy's languages, writing systems, and typography evolved over the millennia.
